sources.title: Audio or video URLs
sources.description: Public URLs of audio or video files: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OPUS, FLAC, MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI and more. Long files are split automatically. Files in your own Apify key-value store work too: set the store's access to "Anyone with ID can read" and use https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/<store ID>/records/<key>.

podcastFeeds.title: Podcast feeds (RSS)
podcastFeeds.description: Podcast RSS feed URLs: the newest episodes are transcribed (with podcast and episode titles and dates).

maxEpisodesPerFeed.title: Episodes per feed
maxEpisodesPerFeed.description: How many of the newest episodes to transcribe from each feed.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language (en, uk, de, es, fr, pl, ru, ...). Leave empty to detect it automatically; setting it improves accuracy for short or noisy recordings.

quality.title: Model
quality.description: accurate = Whisper large-v3 (best for Ukrainian and other non-English languages); fast = Whisper large-v3-turbo. Same price.

crossCheck.title: Cross-check with the second model
crossCheck.description: Recognise the audio again with the other Whisper model and list the places where the two disagree (crossCheck.differences, with times). Noise breaks numbers and short words, and the two models break them differently, so these are the places worth listening to. Doubles the price: each started minute is charged twice.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary hint
vocabulary.description: Optional names, terms and spellings that appear in the recording (e.g. "Lviv, Kyivstar, PrivatBank"). Helps the model spell them correctly. Ukrainian city names are built in when the language is set to English, Ukrainian or Russian.

subtitles.title: SRT and VTT subtitles
subtitles.description: Also save SRT and VTT subtitle files with download links (free).

wordTimestamps.title: Word timestamps
wordTimestamps.description: Add every word with its start and end time (for karaoke captions, search, editing). Free.

translateTo.title: Translate to
translateTo.description: Also translate the transcript and subtitles (SRT/VTT) into this language. Charged as one more audio minute per minute.

summarize.title: Summary and key points
summarize.description: Add a short summary, key points and action items (decisions, tasks, deadlines) for each file. Free.
